<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, carbon signals in the upfield region correspond to methyl carbons. The spectrum shows peaks at 26.40 ppm (typical alkyl methyl), two peaks at 36.40 ppm (likely two methyls attached to heteroatoms or nitrogen), and a peak at 58.70 ppm (consistent with a methoxy methyl). These four distinct carbon environments represent four CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
